project.title: Actual SQLite main-handle identity
project.goal: Distinguish actual SQLite descriptors from restored names and preserve live cross-process locks
project.scope: Pinned dependency identity observation and retained layout comparison; no persistent writer admission

boundary.responsibility: Safe pinned main-handle metadata and sticky comparison without releasing process locks
boundary.rationale: Path ABA can hide wrong open handles and ordinary close can silently release POSIX locks
excludes: Namespace lifetime, product owner/bootstrap, existing data adoption or deployment qualification

scenario.normal.description: Device/inode match and persistent synthetic rows survive reopening

scenario.given: Retained synthetic control/ledger files and matching SQLite handles in WAL or DELETE
scenario.when: Compare live handles, commit, close and reopen
scenario.then: Device/inode match and persistent synthetic rows survive reopening

scenario.refusal.description: Refuse and retain sticky invalidation; no fallback to paths

scenario.given: Memory, swapped, hardlinked, unlinked or wrong-inode SQLite handles
scenario.then: Refuse and retain sticky invalidation; no fallback to paths

scenario.preservation.description: Only integer metadata escapes; no SQL data, locks or namespace mutations

scenario.given: Unchanged control and ledger data with trusted patched default VFS
scenario.then: Only integer metadata escapes; no SQL data, locks or namespace mutations

scenario.correction.description: Path oracle passes but actual handle refuses and stays invalid

scenario.given: Original file retained, alternate database opened at its path then original path restored
scenario.when: Run pathname-only negative oracle then actual handle comparison
scenario.then: Path oracle passes but actual handle refuses and stays invalid

scenario.concurrent.description: Contender stays busy until explicit parent rollback; no accidental lock release

scenario.given: Parent holds BEGIN IMMEDIATE and an actual separate process contends in WAL/DELETE on either database
scenario.when: Run ensure_current and ensure_connections and refuse a substituted manifest hardlink to either live database
scenario.then: Contender stays busy until explicit parent rollback; no accidental lock release

action.sqlite_identity.description: Observe actual main handles and compare retained layout

output.description: Successful physical observation only, no writer authorization

errors.refused: Changed/unavailable/unsupported layout or unsupported SQLite identity VFS

preconditions: Bind retained layout before opening SQLite handles; close all handles before layout drop
Pinned trusted default Unix VFS and bundled dependencies; explicit safe selected company
postconditions: Both actual main descriptors match exact retained files with one link or sticky refusal
No transient regular-file descriptor is opened/closed during revalidation, including refused manifest aliases
No pointer, descriptor, logical authority or write capability escapes
external_effects: Read-only statat/fstat and connection file_control observations; no data/namespace writes

boundaries.rationale: Fixed ABI output and no descriptor/pointer escape; unsupported VFS refuses

concurrency.rationale: statat must preserve actual process SQLite locks

authorization.rationale: Read-only physical observation neither authenticates nor grants rights; deployment authorization remains required outside this action

idempotency.rationale: No persistent effects or mutation retries; invalidation remains sticky in memory

atomicity.rationale: No transactions or persistent mutation; namespace snapshots explicitly do not provide atomic lifetime admission

action.sqlite_identity.behavior: Check layout with no transient DB opens; fstat actual SQLite main descriptors through versioned patched VFS; require exact dev/ino/single-link; any error invalidates layout permanently; recheck layout
